lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are distributed in quasi-vertical columns; a prominent central configuration consists of four high-intensity nodes forming a trapezoidal pattern in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical zones of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance clusters, forming a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes across the anterior and mid-lateral surfaces.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature persists across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge.
